blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–It was a bittersweet day for Nxled, which announced Jonah Sabete-Escamillan’s season-ending ACL injury just moments after securing the No. 1 seed and a twice-to-beat advantage in the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series. The Chameleons beat defending champion Creamline for the first time in franchise history, 25-20, 12-25, 25-21, 25-19, on Tuesday night at Philsports Arena. But Nxled also announced that Sabete-Escamillan will be unable to finish the team’s historic run after she sustained a left knee ACL injury last week during its straight-set win over Akari. “The team extends its full support as she undergoes treatment and rehabilitation.
